question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

I told you not to give my number to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**anyone**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence requires a pronoun that refers to people in general.
 
• **"Anyone" is the most appropriate option as it covers all possible individuals**.(कोई व्यक्ति)
